content.comment_body: Hello [company_name] expert, I have purchased a [product_name] [article_no] PLC. I've enabled web access and set a password. The PLC's IP address is 192.168.0.50. When I use Chrome and enter the IP address, the system prompts for a password. After logging in, I see the HMI options, but after a few seconds I'm logged out automatically. I am then required to re-enter the password, which prevents me from using web access reliably, as it only stays logged in briefly. Can anyone help me identify the cause of this issue?

Hi, I've been running the Web-Server for over an hour without any issues. My [product_name] is connected directly to my PC via Ethernet cable. I suspect the problem is related to your PC's configuration, but I'm not sure of the exact cause. Hope this information is helpful.

analysis.insight_summary: A user reports that after enabling web access on a [product_name] [article_no] PLC, their session is logged out after a few seconds, forcing repeated logins. Another user indicates that their web server runs stably for long periods, suggesting the issue may be related to the affected user's system or settings. This raises concerns about the consistency of remote PLC access via web interface.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects the web access session to remain stable after logging in, without abrupt session termination, so continuous remote interaction with the PLC is possible.
